sourceTitle: Love-Letters Between a Nobleman and His Sister
description: "Love-Letters Between a Nobleman and His Sister" by Aphra Behn is a three-volume novel published between 1684-1687. This pioneering epistolary work follows the scandalous affair between Philander and his sister-in-law Silvia as they flee their families in disgrace.
